meta.title: Ehsan Nouri – Mechanical R&D & Mechatronics
meta.description: Portfolio of Ehsan Nouri: precision mechanical design, experimental prototyping, scientific instrumentation, projects and academic record.

hero.name: Ehsan Nouri
hero.lede: Precision mechanical design, experimental prototyping and scientific instrumentation. From CAD and FEM to a working test rig.

profile.title: Profile
paragraphs: Mechanical R&D engineer working at the boundary between digital simulation and physical prototyping. I design precision mechanical systems in CATIA, validate them with FEM, and build them into test rigs that produce data.

Most of my work sits in regulated engineering environments, where traceability and documentation matter as much as the solution. Outside of work I build my own hardware and software projects, from embedded sensors to Android apps and VR simulators.

note: Currently enrolled, alongside a student assistant role

items.degree: M.Sc. Analytical Instruments, Measurement and Sensor Technology
items.school: Coburg University of Applied Sciences, Germany
note: Thesis: Optimization of a chocolate 3D printer
Teaching assistant: Statics, Mechanics of Materials, Industrial Drawing

bullets: Co-authored technical manuscripts by developing experimental test setups, running laboratory investigations and acquiring reliable empirical data.
Characterized mechanical behavior and structural performance through iterative testing and finite element (FEM) simulation.
Designed precision housings for optical gyroscope systems in CATIA, integrating optical components into stable, manufacturable structures.
Generated manufacturing-ready drawings applying GD&T principles for dimensional accuracy and functional interfaces.
Managed external CNC and additive-manufacturing workflows and validated parts through dimensional metrology.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Investigated critical FDM process parameters in needle-insertion 3D printing to improve inter-layer adhesion and structural strength.
Ran tensile and strain analyses of engineering polymers, combining experimental characterization with quantitative data analysis.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Optimized extrusion mechanics and hot-end thermal stability of the Mycusini 1.0 system through testing and iterative refinement.
Refined firmware and integrated electromechanical field-test feedback to improve motion control and reliability.

items.org: Institut für Prototypen und Modelltechnik (IPM), Germany
bullets: Prototyped an experimental FDM 3D printer, covering mechanical assembly, hardware integration and custom firmware.
Statistically validated the strain performance and repeatability of a new needle-insertion nozzle.
Designed, built and commissioned a satellite transport container for MIL-standard shipment, with full responsibility for mechanical design, structure and subsystem integration.
Designed and fabricated passive Wire Rope Isolators to MIL-STD-810 requirements and characterized them on a magnetic shock test machine.
Designed and built a 2-DOF helicopter test rig for yaw and pitch dynamics, including actuation, instrumentation and integration.
Designed an aerodynamic propeller test unit for thrust and aerodynamic performance evaluation.
Carried out 3D CAD design, precision fabrication, rapid prototyping and experimental validation under MIL and industry standards.
Designed a prototype hybrid solar–wind power generator, covering structure, component integration and electromechanical subsystems.
Assembled and calibrated custom high-precision FDM 3D printers, optimizing hardware, structural alignment and multi-axis motion.
Programmed and debugged open-source Marlin firmware for motion control, thermal management and reliability.
